eli5.text: Freebuff 0.2.13 adds detailed tracking of how users interact with ads and the assistant, capturing data such as typing patterns, tool usage, and system performance to improve advertising models. The update introduces a post-click adoption watch that monitors whether the assistant installs a package from a vendor whose ad was just clicked, recording the event without storing the raw command. ai.title: Add COD-760 ad leg verdict fields to fetch completed telemetry
ai.summary: The `ads.fetch_completed` operational telemetry stream now carries two new string fields, `first_party_outcome` and `house_outcome`, recording the verdict of the paid first-party book and the house ad floor respectively on every completion event. The existing `no_fill_reason` field documentation was expanded to detail the new COD-760 values that name the specific paid leg responsible for a zero-ad response, including Gravity no-fill states and first-party rejection reasons. These fields are intentionally kept separate from the `outcome` field to prevent silent drops in existing dashboard no-fill counts that partition on `outcome`.
